answer: Each identity is a vertex whose weight sits in the umber ledger and falls each epoch without verified work. Renewal needs twenty credits from its own bond and one new receipt bound to its key; one receipt cannot renew two vertices. A rented bond fails: moving it triggers decay, not renewal, and a replayed receipt is rejected on reuse. The tenth fake costs as much as the first, as every idle epoch reapplies the ten-percent delta, so one thousand fakes cost twenty thousand credits and one thousand jobs per epoch, while an honest agent pays twenty credits and one job for full weight.
